ios.desc:
PocketConsole puts the coding agent on your server in your pocket. Say what you want built, watch it happen, and keep going from anywhere. Your agent keeps working while your phone sleeps.

BUILD FROM YOUR PHONE
• Start Claude Code in any project with one tap, or pick up the last conversation
• Write prompts with saved snippets, attach photos and files
• Answer its questions and plan approvals with buttons, no typing commands

KNOW WHEN IT NEEDS YOU
• Notifications when it finishes, fails or needs permission
• Allow or Deny right from the notification
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen while it works

SEE IT, SAVE IT
• Preview the app it's building, straight from your server
• Save your progress with one tap and go back to any earlier save
• Branches, history and uploads to GitHub
• Browse and edit files, watch CPU, memory and running ports

YOUR SERVER, YOUR WAY
• Connect a server you already have: a cloud server, a Raspberry Pi or a Mac
• No server yet? Create one on your own DigitalOcean account in a few taps
• Guided setup installs everything; sign in to Claude and GitHub without leaving the app
• A full terminal with a keyboard bar, tmux sessions that survive disconnects, and Face ID lock

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PocketConsole has no accounts, no ads and no tracking. It connects straight to your server over SSH; your keys stay in your iPhone's Keychain, and notifications are end-to-end encrypted.

POCKETCONSOLE PRO
PocketConsole needs PocketConsole Pro: a monthly or yearly subscription that starts with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Subscription payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends and renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

You need a Claude account to use Claude Code. PocketConsole isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC.
